alphas.name: operating_income_history_position_252_industry
alphas.notes: Switching from profitability delta to profitability history-position produced the first material step-up in both Sharpe and Fitness and became the new live winner.

batch_observation.branch_takeaway: The only meaningful improvement came from changing the representation of the signal, not from slowing the delta window. Raw operating-income history position over 252d raised Sharpe to 1.13 and Fitness to 0.73 while keeping turnover healthy, so the next batch should stay entirely inside the operating-income history-position family. No visible submission-check evidence or non-null subuniverse result was captured, so the correct posture remains polish one more time, not package.
